fact: 1902年5月31日，《弗里尼欣和约》在比勒陀利亚签署，结束第二次布尔战争；布尔代表于当夜十点半在和约上签字。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: On May 31st this resolution was notified to Lord Kitchener, and at half-past ten of the same night the delegates arrived at Pretoria and set their names to the treaty of peace.

fact: 停战前后放下武器的布尔人合计约20000人，其中德兰士瓦约12000人、奥兰治河殖民地约6000人、开普殖民地约2000人；英方估计布尔总兵力不少于75000名骑马武装人员。

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: The surrenders amounted in all to twenty thousand men... About twelve thousand surrendered in the Transvaal, six thousand in the Orange River Colony, and about two thousand in the Cape Colony... the total forces to which we were opposed were certainly not fewer than seventy-five thousand well-armed mounted men

fact: 战争结束时，南非原两个布尔共和国在和约文本中已被改称德兰士瓦与奥兰治河殖民地，英方叙述称'从开普敦到赞比西的整个南非已并入英帝国'。

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: the whole of South Africa, from Cape Town to the Zambesi, had been added to the British Empire.

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The DUTCH language will be taught in public schools in the TRANSVAAL and the ORANGE RIVER COLONY...

fact: 和约第1条要求 field 的布尔军队立即放下武器、交出全部枪支弹药，并停止抵抗爱德华七世国王的权威，承认其为合法君主。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The BURGHER Forces in the Field will forthwith lay down their Arms, handing over all Guns, Rifles, and Munitions of War in their possession or under their control, and desist from any further resistance to the Authority of His MAJESTY KING EDWARD VII., whom they recognise as their lawful SOVEREIGN.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That the burghers lay down their arms and acknowledge themselves subjects of Edward VII.

fact: 和约第3条规定，战时身处南非境外的布尔战俘一旦声明接受爱德华七世国王臣民的地位，即被送回战前住所地。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: All Prisoners of War, at present outside of South Africa, who are Burghers, will, on their declaring their acceptance of the position of Subjects of His MAJESTY KING EDWARD VII., be brought back to the places where they were domiciled before the War.

fact: 和约第4、5条保证投降或返乡布尔人的人身自由与财产不受剥夺，并免于就战争行为提起任何民事或刑事追诉。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The BURGHERS so surrendering or returning will not be deprived of their personal liberty or their property. No Proceedings, CIVIL or CRIMINAL, will be taken against any of the BURGHERS so surrendering or returning for any Acts in connection with the prosecution of the War.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That their liberty and property be inviolate. That an amnesty be granted--save in special cases.

fact: 和约第6条要求在德兰士瓦与奥兰治河殖民地的公立学校按家长意愿教授荷兰语，并在必要时允许在法庭使用荷兰语。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The DUTCH language will be taught in public schools in the TRANSVAAL and the ORANGE RIVER COLONY where the Parents of the Children desire it, and will be allowed in COURTS of LAW when necessary for the better and more effectual Administration of Justice.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That the Dutch language be allowed in schools and law-courts.

fact: 和约第8条确立战后政体路线：军事管理应尽早由文官政府取代，条件允许时引入通往自治的代议制度。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: MILITARY ADMINISTRATION in the TRANSVAAL and ORANGE RIVER COLONY will at the earliest possible date be succeeded by CIVIL GOVERNMENT, and, as soon as circumstances permit, Representative Institutions, leading up to Self-Government, will be introduced.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That self-government be granted as soon as possible.

fact: 和约第9条把给予'native'（土著/黑人）选举权的问题推迟到自治引入之后再决定，战后初期黑人政治身份被制度性搁置。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: The question of granting the Franchise to natives will not be decided until after the Introduction of Self-Government.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That no franchise be granted for natives until after self-government.

fact: 开普殖民地存在仅适用于黑人的宵禁与通行证制度：天黑后外出的黑人须持通行证，并有针对黑人的'劳动法'与《格伦·格雷法》等强制劳动立法（布赖斯1897年记述的战前制度，战争与战后延续）。

sources.title: James Bryce, Impressions of South Africa, 3rd ed. (first published November 1897) (Project Gutenberg eBook #22323)
sources.quote: Cape Colony has a so-called "curfew law," requiring natives who are out of doors after dark to be provided with a pass--a law which is found oppressive by the best class of natives, educated and respectable men, though defended as necessary for public order... There are also certain "labour laws," applying to natives only... a prima facie case for the so-called "Glen Grey Act" and similar laws may, therefore, be made out.

fact: 金伯利戴比尔斯钻石矿以铁丝网封闭、有人把守入口的'compound'（封闭工棚）集中关押约2600名黑人矿工，工资通常每周18至30先令，工人须接受防止夹带钻石的封闭管理（布赖斯1897年记述的矿业合同与身份控制制度）。

sources.title: James Bryce, Impressions of South Africa, 3rd ed. (first published November 1897) (Project Gutenberg eBook #22323)
sources.quote: The most striking sight at Kimberley, and one unique in the world, is furnished by the two so-called "compounds" in which the natives who work in the mines are housed and confined. They are huge inclosures... covered with a wire netting to prevent anything from being thrown out of them over the walls... The De Beers mine compound contained at the time of my visit 2600 natives... They come from every quarter, attracted by the high wages, usually eighteen to thirty shillings a week

fact: 和约第11条设立司法委员会，德兰士瓦1900年第1号法律项下发行的政府纸币及部队官员所开收据须在六个月内申报兑付，无息偿付，且应付总额以300万英镑为上限，超出按比例削减。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: A JUDICIAL COMMISSION will be appointed to which Government Notes issued under Law No. 1 of 1900 of the SOUTH AFRICAN REPUBLIC may be presented within six months... will be paid, but without interest... The sum payable in respect of the said Government Notes and Receipts shall not exceed L3,000,000 sterling, and if the total amount of such Notes and Receipts approved by the Commission is more than that sum, there shall be a pro rata diminution.

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: That L3,000,000 be given to help the farmers.

fact: 和约第12条要求在德兰士瓦与奥兰治河殖民地各区设立由地方法官主持、有当地人代表参加的委员会，协助居民返乡，并向因战争损失无法自给者提供食物、住所、种子、牲畜和农具；政府以无息、可分多年偿还的方式垫付资金。

sources.title: J. D. Kestell & D. E. van Velden, The Peace Negotiations ... which terminated in the Peace concluded at Vereeniging on the 31st May, 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #27529)
sources.quote: a Commission, on which the local inhabitants will be represented, will be appointed in each district of the TRANSVAAL and ORANGE RIVER COLONY, under the Presidency of a Magistrate or other Official, for the purpose of assisting the restoration of the people to their homes, and supplying those who, owing to war losses, are unable to provide for themselves with food, shelter, and the necessary amount of seed, stock, implements, &c. ... Funds for this purpose will be advanced by Government free of interest and repayable over a period of years.

fact: 威特沃特斯兰德（兰德）金矿田于1885年被发现，到19世纪90年代其黄金产量增长速度超过1896年时的预期，构成战后德兰士瓦经济与矿业重建的基础（布赖斯1897年记述）。

sources.title: James Bryce, Impressions of South Africa, 3rd ed. (first published November 1897) (Project Gutenberg eBook #22323)
sources.quote: Discovery of the Witwatersrand gold field 1885... the increase of gold production in the mines of the Witwatersrand has proved even more rapid than was expected in 1896.

fact: 战时布尔平民被集中安置于难民营（英方称refugee camps）；到7月底仅德兰士瓦即有约60000名在营者，奥兰治河殖民地另有约一半。霍布霍斯小姐报告营地死亡率极高，英方调查则把部分高死亡归因于麻疹流行（多伊尔1902年记述）。

sources.title: Arthur Conan Doyle, The Great Boer War, final edition, September 1902 (Project Gutenberg eBook #3069)
sources.quote: By the end of July there were no fewer than sixty thousand inmates of the camps in the Transvaal alone, and half as many in the Orange River Colony... Some consternation was caused in England by a report of Miss Hobhouse, which called public attention to the very high rate of mortality in some of these camps, but examination showed that this was not due to anything insanitary in their situation or arrangement, but to a severe epidemic of measles

fact: 金伯利钻石矿封闭工棚内的黑人矿工工资通常为每周18至30先令；这是布赖斯1897年记述的战前矿山工资水平，可作为战后矿业劳动力报酬的参照，但不等于1902年兰德金矿或白人技工的实际工资。
